name: Frostfire Mine
description: Players gather Orichalcum by occupying veins in a 30-minute battle with unlimited troops that cannot be killed.
requirements: Register and take part on the same day

rewards.name: Orichalcum
rewards.note: Gathered from veins; the amount varies by vein level

rewards.name: Orichalcum per minute
rewards.note: Skill bonus, 1,080 to 5,000 depending on unlocked abilities

tips: Stay on the outskirts of the battlefield to find more patrol guards.
Unlock skills step by step before you collect veins.
Use the 5th ability only during vein outbursts.
Use the free advanced teleporter carefully.
Watch nearby veins occupied by other players so you can loot them.
Use separate gear for killing guards and for occupying veins.
Keep one march in reserve to recall from a vein every minute.
